data.summary:
**When:** [Your Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), as its Reinforcements step begins.

**Target:** A **RUBRIC MARINES** or **SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATORS** unit of yours in [Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves).

**Effect:** If the unit has **RUBRIC MARINES**, it gets **[Deep Strike](vsdata:core-ability/deep-strike)** for the rest of the phase. If it has **SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATORS**, then whenever it is set up with Deep Strike, it can be placed anywhere wholly within the [Flow of Magic](vsdata:ability/thousand-sons.hexwarp-thrallband.flow-of-magic) of your army that is over 6" horizontally from every enemy model.

**Restrictions:** Once targeted by this Stratagem, **SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATORS** units cannot declare a charge that turn.
